source.note: 10114266 - MANUAL, OP & AP, AWF400, AERWAY, 230001+.pdf (Salford Group, 2023-01-10), Specifications p.30, part-number logic p.6, ballasting p.29; the earlier manual 10048738 (XL-AW-A-75581-A Rev G, 12-2015) has the identical table. 'xx' in the model number is the tine-type code. The text extraction of p.30 places a 'C-Flex (5.00in effective spacing)' heading next to the xxX3-CCT row; per the p.6 part-number logic (X = 10in roller tine spacing, CCT = tandem rollers) that row is the CCT 10in configuration, recorded as such. Travel width 19ft 8in converted to inches.
